sequential_dependency.intermediate: The ordered collision records for all four rays: current square position, incoming direction, obstacle color, decoded turn, and outgoing direction.
sequential_dependency.step_a: Decode the color-to-turn legend, then trace each square-width ray through its input-dependent sequence of obstacle collisions and outgoing directions.
sequential_dependency.step_b: Paint the union of square footprints visited by those traced states onto the original scene while preserving every obstacle.
sequential_dependency.why_b_depends_on_a: A footprint after the first collision depends on the obstacle color and decoded left/right command. The same seed and objects produce different downstream corridors when that intermediate turn sequence is changed.

parametric_work.summary: Exact-canonical legend turns plus a reversed-turn alternative; supports 2-6 demonstrations, 1-4 sequentially exposed queries, chained obstacle encounters, and a protected wrong-turn-sequence witness on a 30x30 input.
